item.text: The settings are stored as flattened organization columns, so I’m adding a persisted organization timezone there with a UTC default. I’ll also move overdue counting to the service layer, where the workspace timezone can be applied uniformly to both project reads.

The date helpers now resolve local wall times into UTC instants and use calendar dates for due-date decisions. I’m wiring the timezone through storage and jobs next, including the exact local-hour digest window and the retention cutoff at local midnight.
